content: Pwu Avafalisayo na vankhalani ukhua ku Yerusalemu. Vakhandhutiela u Yesu vakhanchova,
“Khikhi avankhonghi vakho vienangha indagheilo incha vaghogholo veitu? Ulwa khuva savinkhalava amavokho ghavene vuvilya eikyakhula.”
U Yesu akhanda akhavavula ankhata, “Mbhona na yumwe munanga ululaghilo ulwa Nguluve wuu mukhulyuphielila?
Ulwa khuva uNguluve anchovile, 'Umwiemiekhaghe udada vankho na yuo vanina vankho; uvie inkhudhukha udadaye aphange uvanina uva mwene ukhuwa afwinchaghe.'
Hanghe umwe mwinchova, 'Uvikhumbula udadaye na yu vanina va mwene, eikhilondiwa ukhutangheiliwa avatanghe noune khiva khisayiwe nwu Nguluve.”
Umunu uveisinkhu ndwandwa udadaye nu vanina, lua ananghiela eilimenyu lya Nghuluve khumighendele igwumwuphielile.
Umwe mwievadhesi, luononu nduvuu u Isaya anchovile mumalagho pwu akhata,
'Avanu ava vikhunsana une khumilomo gyavene, khumbe ienumbula ncha vene nchilikhutali nune.
Ukhutekhela khuwitekhela vuvule, ulumanyisyo uluviemanyisya lya vanu.”
Akhavielangha avanu akhavavula, “Muphuliekhienche mulumanye—
Khiekyo khikhwiengiela mundomo ugwamu khwisakhiviekha uvuvivi. Eikhihuma mundomo ugwamu eikyou khwio khikhumbiekha umunu uvuvivi.”
Pwu avankhonghie vamwene vakhanduteila vakhambula vakhata, ulumanyiela ukhuta Avafalisayi vakhavile viephulikha eilimenyu liela vakhaviphiele?”
U Yesu akhavavula akhata, “Eikhiemeliele kyene khikhwo Udada vango uvakhukyanya savyaliele, khilukhuphuliwa.
Valekhe, avo valonghonchi avabofwile amiho. Uveisilola amiho anghandongonche uniene yuywa silola, voni vuvavilie vigwa vikhwinghiela mundighuli.”
Pwu uPetro akhamula akhambuncha u Yesu,” Uluvule ikhiekyani,
u Yesu ankhandha akhata, “Nayumwe mukhale samukhulumanya?
Samukhalumanye ukhuta eikhikyunghile mundomo khiluta mundhitumbhu, khinchitaghiwa khulinyasi?
Ulwa khuva iefinu fwoni iefihuma mundomo fikhuma mughati munumbula, vufieliewo ifienu fifwo vikhumbikha umunu uvuvivi.
Ulwa khuva einumbula yiekhumya amasago amavivi, uvubudi, uvulieghu, uvumalalaya, uvulyasi, ukhunchova uvudheisi na ghamadhusi.
Inchi nchu mbombo nchincho nchikhumbikha umunu uvuvivi.”
U Yesu pwakhahegha aphonu phala akhava pavutali akhaluta khuvunchenghe uwa Tilo nakhu Sidoni.
Lola pwa khincha undhala u Nkhanani ukhuhuma uluvafu ulwa, akhatoncha eilimenyu akhanchova akhata, “Inanghe, Ntwa, vinswambe va Daudi; umwalievangho alienimepho iembivi nchikhunganghayiesya eino.”
Umwene sakhamwamula khinu. Avakhonghi vamwene vakhandutiela vakhandhova, vakhata, “Wieng'enche aghodokhaghe ulwa khuva iekhutuyweghela.”
U Yesu akhavandha akhata, une saniekhasuhiewe khuvanu, nliekhasukhiwe khu ng'osi inchiyaghiele incha munyumba ya Israeli.”
Umwene akhincha akham fumiela, akhanchova, “Nkhuludeva weinanghe.”
Akhandha akhata, saluvile lunonu ukhutola eikyakhula ikyavana ulakhiela iembwa,”
Akhanchova, “Ena, Nkhuludeva, nanchimbwa nchihola eikyakhula eikhigwa pasi pha mesa iya Nkhuludeva vavo.”
Pwu u Yesu akhanda akhata, “Viendhala uve, ulweidhikho lwakho luvaha. Nchivombekhe khulyuve nduvukha nogwagwa. “Umwana va mwene akhaphona usienkhe ghugwa.
U Yesu akhahegha pala akhaluta ukhukheghelela nie nyanja iya khu Galilaya. Akhatogha khukyamba aliekhunchima ukhwa.
Avanu avienghi vakhincha khumwene, vakhavaghegha avikyafula, avasavilola, avasavinchova, avalemilwe na vanghe avienghi vavo vale vatamu. Vakhavaviekha mumalunde ghamwene valiekhupona.
Avanu pwu valiekhudhegha ukhuvona vavosavinchova vinchova, avalemilwe viva vanonu, avikwafula vieghenda, na vavo savielola vielola. Pwu vakhanghinia uNguluve uva Vanyaisraeli.

U Yesu akhavilangha avankhongi vamwene akhanchova, “Nikhuvankholela eikhisa avanu ulwa khuva vakhanchighagha nune amanchuva ghadatu savaliele khinu. Saniekhilaghe ukhuta vaghokhaghe nie njala ulwa khuva uyuvienchiliekha munjiela.”
Avankhonghi vamwene vakhambula, “Tunchilonda ndhakhu ifisyesye ifyakhwielanila avanu voni ava ukhuta valye vighute ulwa khuva vienghi hanghe tuliephalunyikha?”
U Yesu akhavavuncha akhata, '“Mleini fisyesye filienghi?” Vakhata, “Saba, ni somba ndebe.'”
U Yesu pwu akhavavula avanu akhata vatame phasi.
Akhatola ifisyesye saba nie somba, akhasana, akhamanyula akhavapa avankhonghi. Avankhonghi vakhavapha avanu.
Avanu vakhalya vakhakwielanila vakhighuta. Pwu vakhalundamanie ifiemenyuleilo ifyasigiele fikhadhiegha fitundu saba.
Avanu voni vavo valiele vale avaghosi avaelfu vanne avadala na vana savavaliewe.
Pwu u Yesu akhielagha khuvanu ukhuta vaghodokhaghe na vope akhatogha munghalava ukhuluta uluvafu ulwa khu Magadani.
